root_cause.text: Off-by-one loop boundary error in `dlm_match_regions()` where the inner loop compares `j <= qr->qr_numregions` instead of `j < qr->qr_numregions`, causing an out-of-bounds read beyond the `qr_regions` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the fix changing `for (j = 0; j <= qr->qr_numregions; ++j)` to `for (j = 0; j < qr->qr_numregions; ++j)` in `fs/ocfs2/dlm/dlmdomain.c`, and the CVE/commit message explicitly states the off-by-one causes reading one entry past the valid range of `qr_regions`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix off-by-one error in loop condition when matching regions to prevent accessing beyond the bound of the remote region array.
intent_record.what: Changed the for loop condition from `j <= qr->qr_numregions` to `j < qr->qr_numregions`.
intent_record.how: The loop now iterates exactly `qr->qr_numregions` times, preventing a one-off out-of-bounds access to the remote region array and ensuring correct comparison of all regions.

    ocfs2/dlm: Add message DLM_QUERY_REGION
    
    Adds new dlm message DLM_QUERY_REGION that sends the names of all active
    heartbeat regions. This message is only sent in the global heartbeat
    mode. If the regions in the joining node do not fully match the ones in
    the active nodes, the join domain request is rejected.
    
    Signed-off-by: Sunil
